lines.speaker: Mr. Croft
lines.en: I want to see the dentist, please.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.en: Can you come at 10 a.m. on Monday, April 24th?
lines.zh: 您在 4 月 24 日星期一上午 10 点钟来可以吗？

lines.speaker: Mr. Croft
lines.en: I must see the dentist now, nurse.
lines.zh: 我必须现在就见牙科医生，护士。

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.en: The dentist is very busy at the moment.

lines.speaker: Mr. Croft
lines.en: Can the dentist see me now?
lines.zh: 牙科医生现在就不能给我看一下吗？

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.en: I'm afraid that he can't, Mr. Croft.
lines.zh: 恐怕不能，克罗夫特先生。

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.en: Can't you wait till this afternoon?
lines.zh: 您就不能等到今天下午了吗？

lines.speaker: Mr. Croft
lines.en: I can wait, but my toothache can't!
lines.zh: 我倒是可以等，可是我的牙痛等不了啊！

drills.en: She buys a new car every year. She ___ a new car last year.
She airs the room every day. She ___ it this morning.
drills.zh: 她今天早上给房间通了风。

drills.en: He often loses his pen. He ___ his pen this morning.
She always listens to the news. She ___ to the news yesterday.
She empties this basket every day. She ___ it yesterday.
drills.zh: 她昨天倒空了这个篮子。

drills.en: It's eight o'clock. When did you see him? I ___ him at half past seven.
drills.zh: 现在 8 点。你什么时候见到他的？我 7 点半见到他的。
